evidence.curator_note: Substrate as drawn: the 2-ethylhexanal molecular ion, labelled 'm/z 128' under the structure. The skeleton is printed as C2H5-CH(H)-CH2-CH(C2H5)-CHO with the gamma hydrogen on C4 drawn EXPLICITLY, an aldehyde H on C1, and '+.' printed above the carbonyl oxygen. LOCALIZATION (convention B): the charge and odd electron are written on the oxygen exactly where the page prints them, [CH:1]=[O+:7], not carried only in the JSON fields. This is the TOP channel: an arrow labelled 'alpha' rising to the right from the molecular ion to 'HC≡O+ / m/z 29'. Radical-site alpha cleavage of the C1-C2 bond, charge retained on the one-carbon fragment. Book draws 0 arc(s) for this step: the arrow carries only the label 'alpha' and the product is written as the formula HC≡O+ with no structure and no fishhook anywhere on this branch. All THREE moves are therefore curator-supplied -- the canonical radical-site triple: <1> the oxygen odd electron into the forming C-O pi bond, <2> one electron of the breaking C1-C2 sigma bond into that same bond (raising C1-O7 from double to TRIPLE, which is what the printed HC≡O+ shows), <3> the other C1-C2 electron departing with the heptyl radical. MS CONTEXT: this page prints no ionisation conditions, so 70 eV EI is the corpus house default and is disclosed here rather than read off the page (the same treatment as IMS9-EQ9.19a/b and IMS8-EQ8.114). Figure 9.8 on printed p247 is the 2-ethylhexanal spectrum and would supply abundances, but it is NOT on this page and the scheme itself prints no percentage, so convention F forbids importing an intensity: every peak_assignment here carries status 'proposed' with no relative_intensity.
